snippet.title: PlayStation - Zera-Chan Puzzle - Pitatto Pair (2001)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Zera-Chan Puzzle: Pitatto Pair is a Puzzle game, developed by GungHo and published by Affect, which was released in Japan in 2001.
